register.labelZh: TURN 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: TURN 表達可以表示機器啟動、關燈,以及調高音量或暖氣。；你可以使用 TURN 描述轉身、翻面、翻身、向外或向上,以及上下顛倒。；TURN 可以表示某人到達、人群出席活動,或某人開始對音樂、藝術或其他事物感興趣。；TURN 表達可以說明一項決定取決於甚麼、某人最後採用甚麼方法、討論如何轉換話題,以及某人或生意如何改善。
register.summaryEn: TURN expressions let you say that a machine starts, a light is switched off or the volume and heating are increased. You can use TURN to describe facing another way, flipping an object, rolling over, pointing outwards or upwards, and becoming upside down. TURN can show that someone arrives, a crowd attends an event, or a person becomes interested in music, art or another subject. TURN expressions can show what a decision depends on, what someone uses as a last choice, how a discussion changes topic, or how a person or business improves.

談論到達、出席和興趣轉變

contextsEn: Control machines, lights, heat and sound
Talk about people arriving, attending and changing their interests
Explain decisions, difficult choices and positive change

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；ON 表達的詞序會改變意思:turn on him=突然襲擊或責怪他turn him on=令他感興趣或興奮turn him on to jazz=令他開始對爵士樂感興趣；使用 it、him、her 或 them 時,請按照以上例子放在正確位置。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Word order changes the meaning of the ON expressions: turn on him = suddenly attack or blame him turn him on = make him interested or excited turn him on to jazz = make him interested in jazz When using it, him, her or them, place the word as shown: turn it on turn him on turn it over turn them over to the police turn it up turn them out turn it upside down
